name: New Relic
summary: New Relic prices by data volume and by user type. The free tier includes 100 GB of ingest a month and one full platform user. Data beyond that costs $0.40 per GB, or $0.60 per GB with Data Plus, and full platform users cost $99 each on Standard or $349 on Pro with an annual commitment.

facts.text: New Relic application monitoring offers distributed tracing to visualize the path of a service request, and defines response time, throughput and error rate as its core performance measures.
Logs can be forwarded by APM agents, the infrastructure agent, Fluentd, Fluent Bit, Logstash, Kubernetes integrations, the Log API, a TCP endpoint or an OpenTelemetry Collector.
Log data is retained for 30 days under the Original Data option and 120 days under Data Plus. Extra retention is available at about $0.05 per GB ingested for each additional 30 days.
An alert condition can be created from a log search by choosing Create alert, which builds an NRQL query for the condition.
Storing data in the EU data center adds $0.05 per GB a month.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 100 GB of ingest a month, 1 full platform user and unlimited basic users, retention of at least 8 days

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: First full user $10, up to 5 full users. Core users $49. Data beyond 100 GB at $0.40 per GB, or $0.60 with Data Plus

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Annual commitment; $418.80 on monthly pay-as-you-go. Unlimited full users, core users $49, same per-GB rates as Standard

hiddenCosts: On the free tier, ingest stops past 100 GB until the next month or an upgrade.
Core users cost $49 each on every paid edition.
Data Plus raises the per-GB rate from $0.40 to $0.60 and includes up to 90 extra days of retention.
